paragraphs: Yehudah ben Dortai, in Shemayah's and Avtalyon's time. He and his son Dortai withdrew and settled in the South, asking why the festival offering does not override the Sabbath: Pesachim 70b. Apparently he was a Sadducee; see there. R. Chiyya bar Va said: R. Yudan ben Dorti taught that it is R. Shimon ben Yochai's view—Jerusalem Peah, chapter 1, halakhah 1.
